rv.q: Orlandersmith’s exploration of the tragedy from a variety of perspectives offers no false hope for racial harmony.
This performance is one of those productions that could go right for your gut and keep you enthralled, but it might leave you wishing it had been delivered in a more conventional dramatic style.
“Until the Flood” is the pinnacle of perfection!

cn.t: Orlandersmith's Ferguson monologues earn praise for their raw, heartfelt power and provocative examination of racial tensions, with critics finding the multiple-character storytelling effective and moving, though reception ranges from perfection to solid.
